author: Lucinda Stuart
text: I just installed mine today and it did the same thing…the needle didn’t retract.  It seems to be working fine, but it hurt so bad when I installed it.  Normally it’s just a slight pinch.  I will double check the glucose readings later before bed too, just to make sure.  It scared me.  I thought it wouldn’t work right.  Not sure why it hurt so bad.  It didn’t bleed, but it was painful.
